description: Prepare exact title, script or caption changes for an existing private video. Returns a Studio approval link; this call does not save copy or start a render. The signed-in user must review and approve there. Approval changes the current run, consumes rerender credits and revokes existing review links. Previous run records are retained. Does not publish. Preserve requestId for unchanged retries.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace override. For a new plan, omit this field so the server resolves the account default. A workspace ID returned by an account read is not a user selection. Supply this field only for a user-selected workspace or the workspace of an existing saved project. Ask only when the server requires selection; never fall back after denied access.
